scope: Local canonical structure, logic and interaction. Publication pending.

checks: 7 deterministic logic fixtures on the synchronous byte kernel and report formatter. Actual File, chunk boundary, 64 MiB, cancellation and timeout cases use the specialist browser suite.
Additional bounded-input, worker/file, privacy, clipboard and homepage cases mapped into required CI.

logic.scope: Deterministic inline JavaScript logic, executed in Node with explicit fixtures.

browser.scope: Real Chromium DOM; clipboard/download APIs simulated; external HTTP(S) blocked.

limitations: Local development evidence. Public behavior and publication unverified.
Browser automation captures copy/download and uses synthetic file selection. Native dialogs and physical-device/screen-reader scope require separate checks.
Synthetic Google endpoints test consent integration. GA4 property reporting is unverified.
Observed caps and Worker behavior do not establish a hard browser heap guarantee.
